comments.note: SettingsView.axaml: DataGrid columns for ExtensionMap use `{ReflectionBinding Key/Value}` as an explicit opt-out (per the project convention established in MoviesListView). Avalonia's compiled-binding mode cannot express `KeyValuePair<string, string>` as a DataGrid column x:DataType without complex generic syntax. A future improvement could extract an `ObservableCollection<ExtensionMapRow>` from the ViewModel to avoid ReflectionBinding entirely.

SettingsView.axaml.cs: Language ComboBox synchronisation in OnLanguageSelectionChanged suppresses re-entrancy by unsubscribing/re-subscribing around programmatic SelectedItem changes. This pattern is robust but slightly verbose; a boolean `_syncingLanguage` guard would be equivalent but clearer to future readers.

comments.note: AC-7 nuance: SettingsView.axaml uses {ReflectionBinding Key} and {ReflectionBinding Value} in the DataGrid ExtensionMap columns. This is the established project convention (same pattern in MoviesListView.axaml which uses {ReflectionBinding} for all DataGrid column and context-menu bindings). All standard {Binding ...} expressions are compiled via root x:DataType="vm:SettingsViewModel". AC-7 is satisfied — the prohibition targets untyped {Binding} expressions, not explicit {ReflectionBinding} opt-ins.

SettingsView.axaml.cs: OnLoaded calls SyncToggleButton(vm.ObfuscationVm.IsEnabled) after awaiting LoadAsync. If LoadAsync throws OperationCanceledException, SyncToggleButton is not called — this is correct (the view is unloading). However if LoadAsync throws any other exception, it propagates uncaught from async void OnLoaded. The current code has no catch-all for non-cancellation exceptions; an unhandled exception in async void would crash the app. A catch(Exception) with logging would be safer.

summary: FAIL — SettingsView.axaml and SettingsView.axaml.cs are well-structured overall and all 8 ACs are met, but two blocking deviations from the established MoviesListView template were found in the code-behind.

BLOCKER 1 (crash risk): async void OnLoaded catches only OperationCanceledException. The MoviesListView template also catches (Exception ex) and sets vm.HasLoadError + vm.LoadErrorMessage. An unhandled exception from async void terminates the process.

BLOCKER 2 (event leak): OnUnloaded does not unsubscribe _vm.ObfuscationVm.PropertyChanged. The MoviesListView template unsubscribes in both OnUnloaded and OnDataContextChanged. The current SettingsView only unsubscribes in OnDataContextChanged, leaving the subscription live between Unloaded and the subsequent DataContext clear, preventing GC of the SettingsView instance.

SettingsView.axaml is clean. Compiled bindings are correctly used throughout. {ReflectionBinding} opt-ins in DataGrid columns follow the established MoviesListView pattern. PageHeaderView Title literal usage is correct.

comments.note: BLOCKING — SettingsView.axaml.cs OnLoaded: the try/catch only catches OperationCanceledException. The MoviesListView reference template (the explicit model for this view) also adds `catch (Exception ex) { vm.HasLoadError = true; vm.LoadErrorMessage = ex.Message; }` (MoviesListView.axaml.cs lines 47-50). Any non-cancellation exception from LoadAsync (e.g. DB failure during spdb_config read) will propagate unhandled from the async void OnLoaded, which terminates the application process. Developer must add a general exception handler consistent with MoviesListView. The exact fix approach (VM error state vs logger-only) is at the Developer's discretion, but the uncaught path must be closed.

BLOCKING — SettingsView.axaml.cs OnUnloaded: the method cancels/disposes _cts but does NOT unsubscribe `_vm.ObfuscationVm.PropertyChanged -= OnObfuscationVmPropertyChanged`. The MoviesListView template unsubscribes in BOTH OnUnloaded (`if (_vm is not null) _vm.PropertyChanged -= OnVmPropertyChanged`) AND OnDataContextChanged. The SettingsView only unsubscribes in OnDataContextChanged. In Avalonia's navigation model, Unloaded fires before DataContext is guaranteed to be cleared, so the subscription can outlive the view's active lifespan, preventing garbage collection of the SettingsView instance while ObfuscationSettingsViewModel (a longer-lived object) holds a reference via the event handler. Fix: add `if (_vm?.ObfuscationVm is not null) _vm.ObfuscationVm.PropertyChanged -= OnObfuscationVmPropertyChanged;` to OnUnloaded, mirroring the MoviesListView pattern.

Non-blocking note: SettingsView.axaml Obfuscation tab — `<TextBlock Text='Errors' IsVisible='{Binding ObfuscationVm.IsBusy}' />` shows the 'Errors' header label only while the operation is in progress. If errors accumulate during the run, the label disappears when IsBusy returns to false (when the user most wants to see them). Consider binding IsVisible to `ObfuscationVm.Errors.Count > 0` or leaving it unconditionally visible. Not a functional bug, but the current UX will feel confusing to users who see errors accumulate and then the 'Errors' heading vanishes.

Non-blocking note: SettingsView.axaml.cs SyncLanguageComboBox uses unsubscribe/resubscribe to suppress re-entrancy during programmatic ComboBox selection. Developer's implementation comment notes that a boolean `_syncingLanguage` guard would be equivalent. Both approaches are acceptable; the current implementation is correct. No change required.
